component.name: ResponderHTTP
component.summary: Send HTTP, WebSocket, gRPC and event-stream requests

description.p: ResponderHTTP is a desktop API client. Type a URL, choose a method, add headers, parameters, a body and authentication, and send. You get the status code, the response headers, the body with syntax highlighting, and a timing breakdown showing where the time went: DNS, connect, TLS, first byte and total.

ul.li: HTTP requests with every common method, form and raw bodies, and per-request redirects, timeouts, TLS verification and proxies
Basic, Bearer, API key and custom authentication
WebSocket connections with a composer and a searchable message log
gRPC calls, unary and streaming, with the schema from server reflection or imported .proto files
Server-sent events shown one by one as they arrive
Collections, environments, history and Markdown documentation
OpenAPI 3.0, 3.1 and 3.2 import and export, in JSON or YAML
Copy any request as a curl command

description.p: Requests run through libcurl, compiled into the app. Everything you create stays on your computer in a local database, and tokens and passwords are encrypted with a key kept in your desktop keyring. There are no accounts, no telemetry and no analytics.

screenshot.caption: An HTTP request with its response, headers and timing

ul.li: gRPC calls, unary and streaming, with server reflection or imported .proto files
Secrets are kept with a key in the desktop keyring
Without a tray, closing the window quits, asking first if work would be lost
